caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner cabinet with a rich, dark brown finish. The cabinet features two distinct sections: the upper section has a glass-fronted door with mullions dividing the glass into four panes, inside of which two shelves are visible. The glass door has arched decorative designs at the top of each pane. The lower section of the cabinet consists of a solid wood door with a pronounced wood grain pattern and a raised, arched panel in its center. Both doors have brass-colored hinges on their right sides. The cabinet is designed with a molded cornice at the top and shaped bracket feet at the bottom, with subtle decorative columns at the front corners. The background is plain and off-white, accentuating the cabinet's form and detail. The drawing includes a small signature in the lower right corner.
title: Corner Cupboard
